analysis.headline: USD/KRW drops 3.0 KRW to 1,330.0 on $1T export milestone & KOSPI 5,137; NDF ~1,333
analysis.summary: USD/KRW fell 3.0 KRW to close at 1,330.0 in Seoul (ECB ref 1,328.45), backed by exporter sales, Korea's $1 trillion export milestone, and KOSPI rising 1.39% to 5,137.89. Overnight, DXY eased to 103.65 from a 103.97 peak on softer US data while 1M NDF held steady near 1,333.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW edges down to 1,460.2 as EUR/USD rebounds from 1.0952 low to 1.0992
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW edged lower to around 1,460.2 (ECB ref 1,460.23). EUR/USD touched a 19-month intraday trough near 1.0952 under dollar pressure before recovering toward 1.0992 as softer US jobless claims and Philly Fed data nudged DXY back to 103.65, while firmer KRW weighed on the cross.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW dips to 830.4 per 100 JPY as USD/JPY hovers just under 160.0
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW declined to around 8.30 KRW per JPY (~830.4 per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.304). USD/JPY consolidated near 159.8–160.0 amid elevated US yields and BoJ intervention watch after 1-year-high Japanese core CPI, while KRW gains in Seoul pulled the cross lower.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW slides over 7 KRW to 1,747.1 as sterling stays near multi-month lows
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW fell over 7 KRW to around 1,747.1 (ECB ref 1,747.08). Sterling remained pinned near multi-month lows of 1.313–1.318 against the dollar after softer 3.6% UK CPI and cautious BoE commentary, while Seoul's won advance to 1,330.0 deepened the cross decline.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW slips to 199.3 on won strength despite steady 6.7128 PBOC fix
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW eased further below 200 to around 199.3 (ECB ref 199.27). Although the PBOC set a steady USD/CNY central parity fix at 6.7128 to contain yuan depreciation, Seoul USD/KRW falling 3.0 KRW to 1,330.0 on exporter sales and Korea's $1 trillion export milestone pulled the cross lower.

AUD.headline: AUD drops to 891.6 KRW as soft jobs data cools RBA bets and KRW rallies
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar fell to 891.6 KRW as weak employment data pushed AUD/USD below 0.670 alongside Seoul's firmer won.

CAD.headline: CAD slips to 929.0 KRW as broad USD strength outweighs 1.1% WTI bounce
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar eased to 929.0 KRW as broad USD momentum lifted USD/CAD even as WTI bounced 1.1% to $83.24 and KRW rose.

CHF.headline: CHF dips to 1,576.6 KRW as haven demand favors USD and won firms
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc declined to 1,576.6 KRW as risk-off haven flows favored USD (EUR/CHF near 0.9262) while KRW gained in Seoul.

CNY.headline: CNY slides to 199.3 KRW on Seoul won gains despite steady 6.7128 PBOC fix
CNY.brief: The yuan slipped further below 200 to 199.3 KRW as Seoul's 3.0 KRW drop in USD/KRW outweighed a steady 6.7128 PBOC fixing.

EUR.headline: EUR edges down to 1,460.2 KRW while rebounding from 1.0952 to 1.0992
EUR.brief: The euro dipped to 1,460.2 KRW, recovering from a 1.0952 trough to 1.0992 as softer US data eased DXY, offset by firmer KRW.

GBP.headline: GBP drops over 7 KRW to 1,747.1 KRW with cable pinned near multi-month lows
GBP.brief: Sterling fell to 1,747.1 KRW as 3.6% UK CPI and BoE remarks kept GBP/USD near 1.313–1.318 while KRW strengthened in Seoul.

HKD.headline: HKD eases to 169.3 KRW tracking Seoul USD/KRW's 3.0 KRW drop to 1,330.0
HKD.brief: Pegged near 7.846 per USD, the Hong Kong dollar eased to 169.3 KRW in line with Seoul's 3.0 KRW decline in USD/KRW.

JPY.headline: JPY dips to 830.4 per 100 JPY as USD/JPY hovers just below 160.0
JPY.brief: The yen slipped to 830.4 KRW per 100 JPY as USD/JPY held near 159.8–160.0 despite 1-year-high Japan CPI while KRW gained.

KRW.headline: KRW rallies 3.0 KRW to 1,330.0 on $1T export milestone & KOSPI 5,137
KRW.brief: The won rose 3.0 KRW to 1,330.0 on Korea's $1 trillion export milestone, exporter sales, and KOSPI (+1.39% to 5,137.89).

USD.headline: USD slips 3.0 KRW to 1,330.0 in Seoul; DXY pulls back from 103.97 to 103.65
USD.brief: USD/KRW closed down 3.0 KRW at 1,330.0 in Seoul (ECB 1,328.45), while DXY eased to 103.65 on softer US data; NDF ~1,333.
